purpose: Define explicit handling of unavailable, denied, timed-out, stale or schema-incompatible sources so partial federated results cannot masquerade as complete answers.

topics.name: DWH Federated Partial Failure
topics.purpose: Define explicit handling of unavailable, denied, timed-out, stale or schema-incompatible sources so partial federated results cannot masquerade as complete answers.

semantics.completeness_rule: Result explicitly declares complete or partial status.
semantics.source_rule: Each omitted/failed source is identified exactly with reason.
semantics.partial_rule: Partial results are allowed only under explicit query/profile policy.
semantics.aggregation_rule: Aggregates over incomplete source sets are marked partial/invalid according to aggregate policy.
semantics.join_rule: Cross-source joins with missing source partitions never masquerade as complete joins.
semantics.authority_rule: Denied source is never treated as merely unavailable to bypass governance.
semantics.failure_rule: Required-source failure hard-fails the federated query.

invariants.rule: Federated DWH access preserves each origin's exact identity, schema, governance, lineage and consistency evidence; combining results never centralizes semantic ownership or silently expands authorization.

hard_gates.condition: denied source retried through alternate path to bypass policy
missing join side treated as empty authoritative set

references.purpose: Failure state attaches to exact plan/source fragment.
Partial result semantics remain explicit through pagination.
